name: COUPDAYS
description: COUPDAYS returns the total number of days in the current coupon period for a bond.
tldr: Calculates the number of days in the coupon period that contains the settlement date.

parameters.name: frequency
parameters.description: Number of coupon payments per year (1, 2, or 4).

basicExample.description: Days in the current coupon period
basicExample.explanation: For a semi-annual bond, this typically returns 180 days under the 30/360 convention.

advancedExamples.title: Actual days in coupon period
advancedExamples.explanation: Basis 1 counts the actual number of days in the period.

howItWorks: COUPDAYS is used to determine the length of the coupon period, which is needed for accrued interest calculations.

howToSteps.name: Calculate
howToSteps.text: Press Enter to get the result.

commonErrors.fix: Use DATE function or valid date serial numbers.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: COUPDAYS works identically in Google Sheets.
googleSheetsEquivalent.notes: Same syntax and behavior as Excel.

faq.question: What is the difference between COUPDAYS and COUPDAYSNC?
faq.answer: COUPDAYS counts total days in the coupon period. COUPDAYSNC counts days from settlement to the next coupon.

faq.question: Why does COUPDAYS return 180 for a semi-annual bond?
faq.answer: Under the 30/360 convention, each semi-annual period is assumed to have 180 days.
